task_completion.description: Navigate to the 'Product Category' window in iDempiere.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The new category must have Search Key: 'OUTDOOR-FURN', Name: 'Outdoor Furniture', Material Policy: 'FiFo' (internally 'F'), and Planned Margin: '20'. The product 'Patio Chair' (M_Product_ID=133) must be updated so its Product Category field points to this new 'Outdoor Furniture' category.
